description: The plot illustrates the maximum activation values across different layers for four distinct model components. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 22, with numeric tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Max Activation Value" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to slightly above 1600, with numeric tick marks at intervals of 200. There are four lines plotted without markers. The blue dashed line, representing "attn_output", begins near 0 at layer 0 and exhibits a steady, gradual increase across the x-axis, reaching approximately 600 at layer 20 before a final upward spike to roughly 900 at layer 22. The orange dotted line, representing "attn_residual", starts near 0, remains low until layer 3, and then experiences a massive spike to approximately 1600 at layer 4; it remains at high values, peaking above 1800 near layer 18, before declining sharply to end near 900 at layer 22. The green dash-dot line, representing "ffn_output", also starts near 0 and spikes to roughly 1600 at layer 4, but immediately drops back down to approximately 200 at layer 5; it shows subsequent peaks near layer 12 at a value of 1000 and layer 21 at a value of 1600, ending near 1200 at layer 22. The red solid line, representing "ffn_residual", follows a similar initial trajectory, starting near 0 and spiking to approximately 1600 at layer 4; it then steadily increases to a peak above 1800 near layer 18, drops sharply to roughly 1000 at layer 21, and ends near 1300 at layer 22.
